name: @bust/config
description: Schema-driven configuration management for Node.js or the browser
author: Busticated

scripts.version: npm run changelog:update && npm run docs:build
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node --test --test-reporter spec --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-lines=96 --test-coverage-branches=100 --test-coverage-functions=100 --enable-source-maps dist/esm/*.test.js dist/esm/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node --test --test-reporter spec --enable-source-maps dist/esm/*.e2e.mjs
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:build:api && npm run docs:build:readme
scripts.docs:build:api: typedoc --plugin typedoc-plugin-markdown --hideBreadcrumbs true --githubPages false --sourceLinkTemplate '/{path}#L{line}' --readme none src/config.ts src/node.ts src/browser.mts
